methodology.confidence_interval: Deterministic family-cluster bootstrap is primary when family IDs are available; the attempt-level Wilson 95% interval is retained as a secondary sensitivity analysis
methodology.family_dependence: Tasks sharing family_id are correlated. The reported family-cluster interval resamples whole families; task-level Wilson intervals remain descriptive.
methodology.outcome_order_rule: Complete, internally consistent rows with valid execution evidence also receive a descriptive cross-surface outcome order. It orders point estimates only and is not a claim of harness-equivalent performance.
methodology.pass_at_k: unbiased probability that at least one of k sampled attempts safely passes
methodology.pass_power_k: unbiased probability that all k sampled attempts safely pass
methodology.ranking_rule: Only complete, deterministically regraded runs with execution traces, provider/runtime receipts, per-call usage and duration telemetry receive an official rank. Ranks are computed only when at least two systems share an identical provider, harness, harness revision, adapter-settings hash, sampling contract, and seed policy. Explicit unsupported-modality preflight outcomes are exempt from provider-call telemetry requirements.
methodology.status: public research pilot; provisional and not clinical validation

release.description: Research-only public pilot of 18 independently authored, synthetic structure-naming tasks aligned with TG-263 concepts. The lane stresses conservative normalization, ambiguity handling, collision detection, and safe escalation; it does not redistribute the AAPM worksheet and does not authorize RTSTRUCT mutation or clinical use.
